# Keep the existing single-path form.
chmod 444 first
exists -readonly first

# chmod accepts all paths in one invocation.
chmod 444 first second
exists -readonly first second

# Relative and absolute paths, including spaces, remain supported.
chmod 666 first second
mkdir nested
cp first nested/third
cp second 'space file'
cd nested
chmod 444 third $WORK/second '../space file'
exists -readonly third $WORK/second '../space file'

-- first --
alpha
-- second --
beta
